spell_node.modern_magic.start.desc: The entry of every spell, casting starts here
spell_node.modern_magic.explosion.desc: Explodes at the position the spell reaches
spell_node.modern_magic.magic_missile.de: Fires a magic missile that flies straight (damage/speed adjustable, higher damage costs more mana)
spell_node.modern_magic.delayed_magic_mi: Fires a missile that continues downstream from its position after flying for a while
Fires a missile that continues downstream from the impact point when it hits something
spell_node.modern_magic.fireball.desc: Fires a fireball that ignites its target (damage/speed/burn adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.ice_bolt.desc: Fires an ice bolt that slows its target (damage/speed/duration adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.poison_dart.desc: Fires a dart that poisons its target (damage/speed/duration adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.wither_dart.desc: Fires a dart that withers its target (damage/speed/duration adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.levitate_dart.de: Fires a dart that makes its target levitate (damage/speed/duration adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.heal_bolt.desc: Fires a bolt that heals the ally it hits (amount/speed adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.water_bolt.desc: Fires a water bolt that douses flames (damage/speed adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.heavy_missile.de: A slow but devastating missile (damage/speed adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.homing_missile.d: Locks onto the nearest target at spawn (damage/speed adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.lightning.desc: Summons lightning at the spell position
spell_node.modern_magic.teleport.desc: Teleports the caster to the spell position
spell_node.modern_magic.pull_pulse.desc: Pulls nearby creatures toward the spell position
spell_node.modern_magic.area_damage.desc: Damages nearby creatures without breaking terrain
spell_node.modern_magic.launch.desc: Flings the caster into the air
spell_node.modern_magic.random_cast.desc: Opens one output port at random
spell_node.modern_magic.echo.desc: Runs downstream nodes several times (count adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.homing.desc: Locks onto the target you aim at, then the nearest living thing (never you), instantly on spawn
spell_node.modern_magic.heal_mod.desc: Downstream projectiles heal instead of damaging (amount adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.burst.desc: Downstream projectiles explode on impact (radius adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.bounce.desc: Downstream projectiles bounce off blocks (times adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.pierce.desc: Downstream projectiles pass through targets (times adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.gravity.desc: Downstream projectiles fall in an arc under gravity
spell_node.modern_magic.pierce_wall.desc: Downstream projectiles ignore blocks and fly through terrain
spell_node.modern_magic.pickup.desc: On hit, collects drops in range into the inventory; teleports them to the caster's feet if full (radius adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.dig.desc: On block hit, digs surrounding blocks (radius/level/drops adjustable; radius cost grows exponentially)
spell_node.modern_magic.chain_dig.desc: On block hit, chains through connected blocks of the same type (radius/level/drops adjustable; radius cost grows exponentially)
spell_node.modern_magic.silk_touch.desc: Applies silk touch to dig and chain dig
spell_node.modern_magic.looting.desc: Improves mob kill drops and adds fortune to digging (level adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.loop.desc: Connect downstream nodes back into an input to loop (input count adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.condition.desc: Routes by pass count: in-range goes to branch 1, otherwise branch 2 (else)
spell_node.modern_magic.terminate.desc: Ends the active branch that reaches this node
spell_node.modern_magic.terminate_all.de: Ends every branch of this wand's current cast
spell_node.modern_magic.rotate.desc: Rotates the flight direction around the vertical axis (angle adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.direction.desc: Rotates the downstream flight direction by relative Euler angles (yaw/pitch)
spell_node.modern_magic.set_speed.desc: Sets the downstream speed multiplier directly
spell_node.modern_magic.wait.desc: Waits for a set time before continuing the output
spell_node.modern_magic.offset_forward.d: Moves the spell position forward along the aim (distance adjustable)
spell_node.modern_magic.offset_up.desc: Moves the spell position upward (distance adjustable)
screen.modern_magic.need_wand: Hold a wand in your hand
screen.modern_magic.unsaved_message: The spell graph has unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
screen.modern_magic.hint_connect_1: Click an input port to connect
screen.modern_magic.hint_default_1: Drag: move | Middle-drag: pan | Wheel: zoom
screen.modern_magic.port_busy: Output port already in use (one wire per port)
screen.modern_magic.need_node: You don't have this spell node
screen.modern_magic.import_confirm_messa: Importing clears the current graph (nodes return to your inventory) and rebuilds it from the file. Continue?
screen.modern_magic.clear_confirm_messag: Remove every placed node and return them to your inventory?
tooltip.modern_magic.quest_book: Right-click to open the quest book
quest.modern_magic.title: Quest Book
quest.modern_magic.altar.title: Settling In
quest.modern_magic.altar.desc: The altar is your workbench for assembling spells and upgrading wands.
quest.modern_magic.crystals.title: Crystal Collector
quest.modern_magic.crystals.desc: Magic crystals fuel your spells and can only be crafted. Gather 24 crystals.
quest.modern_magic.wand.title: First Wand
quest.modern_magic.wand.desc: Craft your first wand at a crafting table.
quest.modern_magic.missile.title: Craft Magic Missile
quest.modern_magic.missile.desc: Craft a basic Magic Missile node and make your wand actually fire.
quest.modern_magic.nodes.title: Node Scholar
quest.modern_magic.nodes.desc: Snow golems always drop Unknown Nodes, which may contain spell nodes. Collect 8 different node types.
quest.modern_magic.duplicate.title: Node Duplication
quest.modern_magic.duplicate.desc: Place any node in the crafting grid center with a Magic Crystal on each of its four sides to duplicate it into two.
quest.modern_magic.spell_edit.title: Spell Craft
quest.modern_magic.spell_edit.desc: Place a spell node in the altar's assembly screen and connect it to the start node to compose your first spell.
advancements.modern_magic.root.title: Modern Magic
advancements.modern_magic.root.desc: Begin your journey into legendary magic
advancements.modern_magic.duplicate.desc: Hold at least 2 of the same spell node
tooltip.modern_magic.unknown_node: Right-click to open: 10% chance for a random spell node, 90% chance for a snowball.
quest.modern_magic.unknown_node.title: Unknown Node
quest.modern_magic.unknown_node.desc: Snow golems always drop an Unknown Node. Right-click it: 10% chance for a random spell node, 90% chance for a snowball.
